issue.body: Filing the release bug for this month since I haven't seen it yet.

body: Re-running the job with added set -x to get more information

```
reprepro -C jdk1.8 includedsc testing 0.4.3/bazel_0.4.3.dsc
No section and no priority for 'bazel', skipping.
There have been errors!
```

The problem comes from the repro pushing
For the reference the rest of the push was sucessful: https://storage.googleapis.com/bazel/0.4.3/rc1/index.html
Gosh the package is label 0.4.1 instead of 0.4.3rc2 for debian
Ok the release is generated from the CHANGELOG...

So my findings:

  1. No section and no priority for 'bazel', skipping. is coming from the absence of said section in the [dsc file](http://ci.bazel.io/view/Bazel%20bootstrap%20and%20maintenance/job/Bazel/1095/JAVA_VERSION=1.8,PLATFORM_NAME=linux-x86_64/artifact/output/ci/bazel.dsc/*view*/)
  2. The version number in the dsc file is generated with `scripts/packages/convert_changelog.py` which is wrong
  3. `bazel build --embed_label=0.4.3rc1 --workspace_status_command=scripts/ci/build_status_command.sh scripts/packages:bazel.dsc` to repro the build of the dsc from the release branch

http://ci.bazel.io/job/Bazel/JAVA_VERSION=1.7,PLATFORM_NAME=linux-x86_64/1098/artifact/output/ci/bazel.dsc/*view*/ and http://ci.bazel.io/job/Bazel/JAVA_VERSION=1.8,PLATFORM_NAME=linux-x86_64/1098/artifact/output/ci/bazel.dsc/*view*/ both actually shows a section in Package-List, still investigating

Ok I am confused, according to our history (rebuilt from various time) we never had Section nor priority section in the dsc (cannot confirm because we lost the builds), adding them fix the issue, I'll bake a patch.
